title: TRACE: Your Diffusion Model is Secretly an Instance Edge Detector

layout.note: Two halves side by side with bold titles underneath. Each has a long process arrow on top between an image tile and a noise tile, and square tiles below: (a) two rows by four timesteps, (b) one row of four timesteps over a row with edge maps at both ends and two green stage boxes between them.

lesson: Show a phenomenon as a grid of per-timestep tiles (rows = map type, columns = timestep), mark the first timestep where it appears with a coloured frame and a dashed box, then reuse the same tile grammar for the method so the green stage names attach to the exact tile and edge maps they act on.
